prompt: A cube has each face with area $9$ cm². What is the total SA?
hint: The area of one face is already given, so you do not need the side length. How many faces does a cube have?

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Picture the cube unfolded into a net. You would see the same $9$ cm² square repeated once for each face.
The area of one face is already given, so you do not need the side length. How many faces does a cube have?
A cube has $6$ equal faces and each has area $9$. Multiply $6$ by $9$ to get the total.
$6 \times 9 = 54$, so the total surface area is $54$ square centimeters.

explanation: The total surface area is the sum of the areas of all the faces of the cube.
A cube has $6$ faces, and every face has the same area, $9$ square centimeters.
Adding six equal areas is the same as multiplying: $6 \times 9 = 54$.
The total surface area of the cube is $54$ square centimeters.
